subject: Microcase clip: 90s interview + usage clearance
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Li <tom.li@wellbridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Microcase clip: 90s interview + usage clearance

Hi Tom —

Great talking yesterday. Following up on the idea we discussed: Redwood would love to capture a short "microcase" interview with WellBridge that highlights the product impact (90s primary asset + 30s social cut). The goal is a candid customer clip we can use on our website and social channels.

Proposed basics:
- Duration on-site: 45–75 minutes (interview + quick B-roll).
- Deliverables: 90s hero interview, 30s social cut, + 3 still frames.
- Usage: Redwood requests perpetual, non-exclusive rights for marketing across web, social, trade shows; we will request no product screen PHI in any public-facing footage.

Can you confirm:
1) Which folks would be comfortable on camera (names/roles)?
2) Are the dates May 20–22 workable? We can do a half-day slot.
3) Any corporate legal or procurement contacts we should loop in for the release?

I've attached a draft consent (microcase_consent_v1.pdf) that covers standard likeness + limited PHI redaction language — we can adjust per WellBridge legal.

If this works, I'll loop in our producer (Ben) and Marissa from CS to coordinate talking points and prep.

Thanks — excited to make this easy.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0143

From: Tom Li <tom.li@wellbridge.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dr. Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@wellbridge.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@wellbridge.ai>, contracts@wellbridge.ai
Date: Tue, 11 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Microcase clip: 90s interview + usage clearance

Jordan —

Thanks for the note. We are interested. Dates: May 21 looks best for our calendar (team offsite on the 20th). Participants who can speak to outcomes:
- Dr. Priya Sharma (Chief Medical Officer)
- Samir Patel (Head of Product)

We will need our legal team to review the consent — looped in (contracts@wellbridge.ai). A couple of constraints from our side: no PHI or patient-identifiable screens in footage; any clinical remarks must be high-level (outcomes > individual cases). Also, we prefer DocuSign for final signature.

Samir and Priya are copied to coordinate a time block; they prefer morning. Once you share a run-of-show and a simple list of talking points, we can lock the slot.

Cheers,
Tom
Tom Li
Director of Partnerships, WellBridge Health

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@wellbridge.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2026 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Microcase clip: 90s interview + usage clearance — planning thread

Looping you all in to turn this into a quick production plan. Key asks from Tom: May 21 AM, two on-camera participants (Priya, Samir), legal (contracts@wellbridge.ai) will review consent, DocuSign preferred.

Draft run-of-show (rough):
- 08:30 — crew on-site (camera, lights, sound check)
- 09:15 — interview with Priya (30–40 min including set-up)
- 10:15 — brief B-roll (team at desks, product demo shots with anonymized screens)
- 11:00 — interview with Samir

Prep items:
- Marissa: can you draft 3–4 talking points per subject (impact metrics, a quick ROI anecdote, top product benefit) and share by EOD?
- Ben: confirm crew headcount and gear list; note PHI redaction steps.
- Evelyn: any immediate legal redlines on the attached consent? I attached talking_points_draft.md as a starting point.

Attachments: talking_points_draft.md (stub)

Thanks — Jordan

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@wellbridge.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Microcase clip — production notes and checklist

Thanks Jordan. I can run this. Quick production notes:
- Crew: 2-person kit (DP + audio) is fine for an interview-first setup. We will bring a single-camera kit (A7s3-level), lav + boom, LED panels, and a small softbox.
- Time buffer: allow 45–60 minutes per interview to get natural soundbites.
- For screens: we'll ask for a sanitized demo machine from Samir (no PHI). If a live system is needed, we'll capture the interface with b-roll-only, then blur in post.
- Props: company laptop, 1 branded mug (if allowed), three still frames of participants for social assets.
- COVID / site safety: crew double-vaccinated; we have rapid test kits if site policy requires.

Attached a field checklist we use (field_shoot_checklist.pdf). Also recommend a short pre-call with Priya/Samir 48 hours out to run through talking points — it's quick and keeps interview tight.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Producer, Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@wellbridge.ai>, contracts@wellbridge.ai
Date: Wed, 12 May 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Microcase clip — legal/ops checklist

Thanks for looping me in. A few legal ops notes after a quick read of microcase_consent_v1.pdf:
- Usage: we can accept perpetual, non-exclusive marketing rights, but we must explicitly state "no clinical claims attributable to named individuals"; please include a clause that allows WellBridge to request takedown of specific clips that contain regulated content.
- Exclusivity: do not include any exclusivity period that prevents WellBridge from working with other vendors; Redwood should accept non-exclusivity.
- PHI: add explicit language that the customer will ensure no PHI appears in footage and that Redwood will not be responsible for third-party disclosures if PHI is provided inadvertently.

I've attached an updated release template (signed_release_template_v3.docx) with tracked changes. For signatures, we'll propose DocuSign (link below). If WellBridge legal wants edits, have them mark the DocuSign comments rather than a redlined Word to avoid parallel versions.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/ABC-123-WELLBRIDGE

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Director, Legal Operations, Redwood Inference

From: contracts@wellbridge.ai <contracts@wellbridge.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Tom Li <tom.li@wellbridge.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Microcase clip — consent review

Evelyn / Jordan —

We reviewed the release. We can sign with two small edit requests:
1) Add a clause that any statistics cited must be accompanied by a citation or internal data source (to avoid implied clinical claims).
2) Limit social snippet usage in paid ads for 12 months unless we explicitly opt-in.

Both are minor; if you share the DocuSign with those two changes we can countersign. We'll assign Priya or Samir as the signatory.

Please set the DocuSign audience to include Priya Sharma and Samir Patel.

— WellBridge Contracts Team
contracts@wellbridge.ai
